title: IOCL WR Apprentice Recruitment 2026
post_wise_vacancies: Trade Apprentice (Fitter / Electrician / Electronics Mechanic / Instrument Mechanic / Machinist)
Trade Apprentice Data Entry Operator (Fresher & Skill Certificate Holders)
Technician Apprentice (Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation / Civil / Electrical & Electronics / Electronics)
category_wise_vacancies: Post Name
Eligibility Criteria
Trade Apprentice (Fitter / Electrician / Electronics Mechanic / Instrument Mechanic / Machinist)
Candidates must have passed Class 10th (High School) with 2 year ITI by NCVT / SCVT in relevant trade.
Technician Apprentice (Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation / Civil / Electrical & Electronics / Electronics)

Candidates must have passed 3 years regular full time Diploma in relevant Engineering discipline with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates for reserved positions from a recognized Institute/ University.
Graduate Apprentice

Candidates must have passed Graduate (BA/B. Com/ B.Sc/BBA.) in any discipline with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates for reserved positions from a recognized Institute/University.
Trade Apprentice Data Entry Operator (Fresher & Skill Certificate Holders)

Candidates must have passed Class 12th (Intermediate) from a recognized Board or Institute. For the Fresher category, candidates require a minimum of 50% aggregate marks (45% for SC/ST/PwBD), while Skilled Certificate Holders must additionally possess an NSQF-recognized ‘Domestic Data Entry Operator’ Skill Certificate for training under one year.
